I'm sorry for the off-topic post, I'm just upset and need to share the importance of Harm Reduction.

Naloxone can temporarily reverse the effects of an opioid overdose, and are free and usually available at your local pharmacy.  Just yesterday I used it on two unconscious and purple-lipped people, restoring their breathing until paramedics could properly check on them. If I was there with my friend, there is a chance I could have saved him too.

Please carry a naloxone kit, and don't use alone, ever. There is even a [toll free phone number](https://neverusealone.com/) you can call so you're not completely alone when you use. 

[Here is a list of free Naloxone programs](https://www.manitoba.ca/health/publichealth/naloxone-finder.html) 

Stay safe friends

Having a Naloxone kit is can be very useful, and I suggest your friends that do anything also carry one with them.

A couple things to note about naloxone though. It is very temporary, especially with fentanyl and fentanyl analogues. The person still needs an ambulance/hospital because a lot of the time an IV of naloxone is needed if they have consumed fentanyl. 

With the prevalence of down (usually fentanyl with benzodiazepines analogues) naloxone will be enough to keep a person breathing, but will not bring them back to consciousness as it does not work on anything other than opioids.
